prep.summary: Transitioned ownership of Tech Strategy to Mike Henry during your last process alignment—positioning you as his Executive Sponsor—while your recent sync with Aaron focused on the unresolved Intelligent Printer dispute. Robert Lagutus is pushing to transfer this legacy platform to Property and Casualty due to Regulation W compliance—a move that carries an unfunded migration cost of $1.5M to $2M and contradicts established platform ownership precedents.
tasks: Establish your executive sponsorship guidelines with Mike—clarifying boundaries for his newly assumed Tech Strategy process ownership.
Deliver the two-to-three-sentence talking points on the Intelligent Printer dispute to Aaron—focusing on the unfunded $1.5M to $2M migration cost.
Share the email thread involving Mike Wilkins and Robert Lagutus with Aaron—providing necessary context on the Regulation W claims.
Align with Mike on the technology acquisition and GSP intake routines—ensuring the transition from Tech Fellows to Directors proceeds smoothly.

prep.summary: Your last meeting with Sai on May 8 addressed severe governance bottlenecks—specifically the Gen AI Council and Model Risk Management reviews halting progress on Intelligent Document Processing. You discussed transitioning from dozens of small initiatives to a focused 'Big Rocks' strategy to stabilize delivery during a leadership transition. You also debated the need for a standardized 'playbook' to check vendor AI risk in days rather than months.
tasks: Establish a simplified vendor AI risk assessment playbook to bypass the current Model Risk Management bottleneck.
Align on the final resource allocation for the two to three designated 'Big Rocks' use cases.
Re-engage the startup platform Pace for a technical demo of its agentic capabilities as planned in your March sync.
Clarify the decision ownership boundaries between InfoSec and Privacy to unblock in-flight capabilities.
